test_reindex_basic: test the MultiIndex.reindex method with a list of tuples as the target index
test_reindex_level: test the MultiIndex.reindex method with a specific level parameter for partial matching
test_reindex_preserves_names: test that MultiIndex.reindex preserves level names when target is a list or ndarray
test_reindex_empty_with_level: test MultiIndex.reindex with an empty level target and verify empty result codes
test_get_indexer: test the MultiIndex.get_indexer method returns identity indexer for exact match input
test_reindex_non_unique: test that Series.reindex raises ValueError when target MultiIndex is non-unique
test_reindex_limit_arg: test that MultiIndex reindex with limit argument raises ValueError without fill method
test_reindex_nested_multiindex: test reindex_like on DataFrames with nested tuples and None values in MultiIndex
test_reindex_not_all_tuples: test MultiIndex.reindex when target index contains non-tuple elements mixed with tuples
